The giant of 21:20 is unnamed, so linking him as a person called "the giant in Gath" or "man of great stature" is not a real identification. Jonathan's father is Shimeah (Shimei); Jonadab was his brother and is not named here. Goliath at 21:19 stays: the Hebrew reads "Goliath the Gittite", while 1 Chronicles 20:5 reads "Lahmi, the brother of Goliath". Whether Samuel has lost a word or Chronicles smoothed the text is debated (see the notes on this verse).
